retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style group portrait featuring warm, hazy outdoor lighting and a prominent psychedelic bubble-lettering logo centered at the top.
triggerTerms: vintage group portrait with warm haze
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: Four long-haired musicians sitting on a low brick wall against a bright, overexposed sky, topped with a thick-stroked, halftone-textured psychedelic script logo.
coreVisualRelationships: Logo centered in the upper third negative space
Subjects arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds
Warm golden-hour light contrasting with a cool purple border
Textural contrast between smooth skin and grainy halftone lettering
coreInvariants: Thick, multi-layered outline on the display text
Overexposed, bright white background behind the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects seated in a row, occupying the bottom half of the frame at a medium-full scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized script logo at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold logo, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and follows their seated line across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright white space in the upper half surrounding the logo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals and denim blues in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white background for high-key exposure.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lavender/purple used for the outer border and logo outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photo with high value (brightness); high saturation in the graphic border.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with exaggerated x-height and rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy drop-shadow or offset outline effect
Internal halftone dot pattern for texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters featuring cloud-like, bulbous bases
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone display lettering; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic volume and curvature.
Provides the thick, rounded script skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style outdoor portrait of four men with long hair and vintage clothing (denim, vests) sitting on a brick wall. Use warm, hazy lighting and an overexposed white sky in the top half. Add a solid purple border around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a custom bubble-script logo in the top center. Use a cream fill with a blue halftone dot pattern and a thick purple multi-layered outline.

verificationChecks: Is the logo centered in the white space?
Does the lettering have a halftone texture?
Is there a solid purple border around the frame?
Is the lighting warm and hazy?

adjustableVariables: Specific clothing items (e.g., more leather vs. more denim)
mustRedesign: Dark or busy backgrounds behind the text

mustAchieve: Authentic 70s film grain and color cast
High-key lighting in the upper half

postGenerationChecks: Check for thick, multi-layered outlines on text
Ensure the sky is bright white/overexposed
Verify the presence of a solid color border
Confirm the subjects have 1970s-appropriate hair and attire
Check for halftone dot patterns inside the lettering
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Band Portrait = (70s Group Photography + Overexposed Sky) + (Psychedelic Bubble Script * Halftone Texture) + Solid Border Frame
